title: We can now run HTML files within a sandbox on our gaming website! (: nearly 80 games
author: Unfair-Frosting-4934

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body: at first was having a file size cap limit issue but realized its most likely most host issue so we are testing \~300mb files for now but this one is about \~158mb and ran no issues so excited to see as I build the infrastructure out what other sorts of games we could host internally

comments.author: Sabatoshi
comments.body: slopdeck. Your play button on games doesn't even work, then 5 minutes later it loads the game. Ugly UI, obnoxious UI, slop games.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
Doesnt work but loads 5 minutes later? Maybe that was a specific game. Could you provide me more info so I can see if this is a one off issue because we havent gotten that complaint 

I appreciate your feedback on the UI. some like it, some don't.   
The games however I would argue are not slop. I purposely curated them from threads I found with nice gameplay and concepts. 

Again if you don't like it I appreciate your feedback .

replies.author: Sabatoshi
replies.body: I clicked over 20 games and it doesnt work. The games all look like slop.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: That doesn't really help me address the issue but thanks again.

replies.author: Sabatoshi
replies.body: It's okay, it's an issue that should've never been caught by a user.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
Okay? ... 

Again the games and the website seem to be working **just fine for every other of the hundreds of visitors**  we are getting so I really don't need your negative feedback that offers nothing positive anymore. Good day.

comments.author: brother_spirit
comments.body:
Test your website before you bother promoting it.  
Out of your "Top Picks" 2/4 error 404, 1/4 freezes on the safety "I'm 18+ gate" and then the one that did load was a generic AI one shot slop demo.  
Lame.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
Could you be a little more specific if it’s certain titles not loading that could be on the developer end if it’s a url. 

I cannot “test” feedback without others interacting with the site and getting first impressions. Which I cannot do if I do not post it publicly 

Thank you for your feedback I will look into these and correct them

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
Hey there my friend, thanks again for your feedback. 

I added in a feature button "Not Working" which will flag titles that are experiencing issues, there is a field to add in more detail specifics so we can look into whether its something we can fix on our end or have to let the developer know about.
